in_hebrew.name: Evy
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Evy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Evy was a goddess of life and the breath of life. She was also associated with the Greek goddess Aphrodite and represented love, beauty, and fertility.

in_greek.name: Evy
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Life, breath
in_greek.long_meaning: Evy είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. In Greek mythology, Evy was a goddess of life and the breath of life. She was also associated with the Greek goddess Aphrodite and represented love, beauty, and fertility.

in_latin.name: Evy
in_latin.meaning: Originating from Greek name Εύη (Eúē), meaning 'good' or 'well-being'.
in_latin.long_meaning: Deriving from Greek root εὖ (eû), signifying excellence, happiness, or flourishing. In early Christian tradition, the name Eúē (Εὐή) was associated with virtue and moral excellence. The Latinized form, Evy, carries on this significance, reflecting the Christian values of goodness and well-being.
